title: Longitudinal multi-omic immune profiling reveals age-related immune cell dynamics in healthy adults 4083

evidence_spans.quote: revealing new features of immune dysregulation with healthy aging
we used multi-omic profiling (scRNA-seq, proteomics, flow cytometry)

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This primary human study analyzes age-driven immune-cell changes using an explicit current-report multi-omic profiling approach.

causal_design_reviewer.comparator: Other immune cell subsets; younger age is implied but not explicitly contrasted
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Immune cell states and immune dysregulation, including memory B-cell responses to vaccination
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: T cells earlier in differentiation accumulated distinct age-related transcriptional changes more than other immune cells.

evidence_spans.quote: Our study uncovers key age-driven shifts in immune cell states, identifying potential drivers of immune dysregulation
